pr_title: Fix polls not being validated on edition

issue_context.title: Streaming API and REST API language filtering is inconsistent
issue_context.body:
### Steps to reproduce the problem

1. select chosen languages in `/settings/preferences/other`
2. open the public timeline
3. observe new posts appearing
4. refresh page

### Expected behaviour

refreshing the page should result in the same posts

### Actual behaviour

streaming gets more posts than REST API

### Detailed description

At first glance, this seems to be due to the language filtering logic being different in the streaming server (`streamFrom` function) and the Ruby server (`PublicFeed#language_scope`):
- the streaming code treats posts with an unknown language as acceptable (`payload.language !== null `)
- when language filtering is enabled, the Ruby code does not return posts with `language: nil`

### Mastodon instance

mastodon.social

### Mastodon version

v4.3.0

### Technical details

_No response_
comments:
It seems like up until #19291, the REST API and the streaming API were consistent, both including posts in chosen languages (if defined) as well as unknown languages. Then #19291 changed the filtering for the REST API (but not the streaming) to only include posts in the chosen languages (or, if not defined, to the user's language). #20294 changed it again to include posts in the chosen languages (if defined) but *not* posts made in unknown languages.

I think it probably makes sense to update the streaming server to be in accordance with the REST API.

review_comments:
I realize this was just moving around existing code, not something changing here, but...

- In the parent class we have a presence validation on `expires_at` which runs when poll is local
- This validator class runs on local and expires_at_changed?

It seems sort of odd to add a "too long" error when the value is missing, given that it will already have the presence validation error added. I wonder if we could have this validator only run when expires_at is present (and keep the changed, and poll is local checks as-is) - which would let this validator remove those extra checks, assume it has a value, and just do the too_long/too_short checks?
